notes: Only predictions locked before kick-off by the daily run are scored. Backtests and any retrospective predictions are never mixed in.

Differences are the model's log loss minus the other forecaster's (negative = model better), with a 95% interval. With few matches the intervals are wide. Matches needed is roughly how many matches it would take to detect a gap the size the backtest found (0.08 in log loss against base rates, 0.02 against the market).
Market probabilities come from closing odds with the margin removed proportionally (an assumption). They appear a few days after each match.
